hotspots.title: Trump’s vaccine order sparks medical backlash
hotspots.blurb: President Trump signed an executive order reducing recommended childhood vaccines from 18 to 11, including splitting the MMR vaccine into three separate shots. The move has drawn sharp criticism from medical experts and lawmakers, who warn it could undermine public health efforts.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to its polarizing nature, linking to deep-seated fears about vaccine safety and government overreach, while also invoking moral panic over public health.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei’s corruption scandal engulfs top aide
hotspots.blurb: Manuel Adorni, a top aide to Argentine President Javier Milei, has been ordered to justify a $43 million peso and $402,000 dollar increase in his wealth within 15 days. The case has sparked allegations of illicit enrichment and deepened political tensions within Milei’s administration.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to its high-stakes implications for Milei’s reform agenda, combining moral outrage over corruption with fears of political instability in Argentina.

hotspots.title: Vox’s constitutional crusade against Spain’s PM over Ceuta
hotspots.blurb: Vox is pushing for a constitutional investigation into Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez over his handling of the Ceuta migration crisis, where over 70,000 migrants entered the Spanish enclave in a single day. The party accuses Sánchez of treason and demands stricter border controls.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to its high moral and political stakes, framing migration as an existential threat to national sovereignty and invoking fears of government betrayal.

hotspots.title: AfD’s surge in German state elections
hotspots.blurb: The far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) is leading polls in Saxony-Anhalt with 42% support, ahead of the September 6 state election. The party’s rise has sparked fears of a historic far-right victory in Germany, with potential implications for national politics.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to its alarming implications for German democracy, combining fears of far-right governance with polarized debates over immigration and national identity.

hotspots.title: Farage vs. Binface: UK by-election showdown
hotspots.blurb: Nigel Farage faces off against parody candidate Count Binface in a UK by-election after resigning amid a financial probe. Farage’s Reform UK party is pushing hardline immigration policies, including deporting foreign criminals to El Salvador, while facing internal divisions and public backlash.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to its high-profile nature and the intense polarization surrounding Farage’s immigration stance, which taps into fears of national decline and cultural erosion.
